questions.question: Why can video games be analysed as cultural texts?
options: They have complex narratives and characters and reflect cultural values
questions.explanation: Games offer complex narratives, interactive storytelling and global cultural impact — worthy of analysis.

questions.question: What is player agency?
options: The ability of players to make meaningful choices
questions.explanation: Player agency is what distinguishes games from film: players make meaningful choices that shape the experience.

questions.question: What are gameplay mechanics?
options: The rules and systems that define how a game works
The people who repair gaming computers
questions.explanation: Gameplay mechanics are the rules and systems — movement, combat, resource management — that define how a game works.

questions.question: What is world-building?
options: Creating a fictional universe with consistent rules and history
questions.explanation: World-building creates a fictional universe with consistent rules, geography and history.

questions.question: What makes games different from films as storytelling media?
options: Interactivity — the player participates in the story
questions.explanation: Interactive storytelling and player agency set games apart from passive media like film.
